caption: The drawing depicts a single brass bell mounted on an ornate black metal frame. The bell is golden yellow in color, with a slightly darker shade near its base and a metallic appearance. The frame holding the bell is decorative with curved patterns resembling scrollwork, colored in shades of dark gray and black. The bell and frame assembly sit atop a rectangular wooden base that is brown with visible wood grain texture. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details. In the lower right corner, there is a small signature.
title: Bell from Ship
